en.title: Deductions
en.summary: Advances, penalties and anything else to be taken off a month's pay.

sections.heading: Entering it
sections.body:
1. Pick the month at the top.
2. Add the deduction against the employee, with its amount and reason.
3. Save.

It is picked up by that month's payroll run and appears on the payslip.

sections.heading: Timing
sections.body: Enter deductions before you run payroll for the month. Anything added afterwards is not in the run — it either waits for the next month or has to go through a payroll adjustment.

sections.heading: Where to see them
sections.body: The Compensation report carries the deductions ledger for any range, filtered by branch, department or person. That is the copy to take when somebody queries what came off their pay.

am.title: ተቀናሾች
am.summary: ቅድሚያ ክፍያ፣ ቅጣትና ከወሩ ደመወዝ የሚቀነስ ሌላ ማንኛውም ነገር።

sections.heading: እንዴት እንደሚገባ
sections.body:
1. ከላይ ወሩን ይምረጡ።
2. ተቀናሹን ከመጠኑና ከምክንያቱ ጋር በሠራተኛው ላይ ይጨምሩ።
3. ያስቀምጡ።

በዚያ ወር ደመወዝ ውስጥ ተካቶ በደመወዝ ወረቀቱ ላይ ይታያል።

sections.heading: ጊዜው
sections.body: ተቀናሾችን ለወሩ ደመወዝ ከማስኪያዎ በፊት ያስገቡ። ከዚያ በኋላ የተጨመረ በክፍያው ውስጥ አይካተትም — ወይ ቀጣዩን ወር ይጠብቃል ወይም በደመወዝ ማስተካከያ ማለፍ አለበት።

sections.heading: የት እንደሚታዩ
sections.body: የካሳ ሪፖርት የተቀናሾችን መዝገብ ለማንኛውም ክልል በቅርንጫፍ፣ በክፍል ወይም በሰው ተጣርቶ ይይዛል። አንድ ሰው ከደመወዙ ስለተቀነሰው ሲጠይቅ የሚወሰደው ያ ነው።
